##### Project general facts

Riviera 55 by Azizi is a contemporary residential building within a Riviera-inspired waterfront community, combining geometric facade lines with an elegant and harmonious character. The building rises from a ground floor to eight residential floors, offering studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments together with premium retail units at street level. Every home has a balcony, while panoramic windows open views of the skyline, the crystal lagoon and the lush greenery of the community.

The building has its own extensive amenities, including landscaped gardens, a large swimming pool for adults and children and relaxation areas with cabanas and sun loungers. A fully equipped gym, an indoor yoga space, a co-working space, a club lounge, a cinema, an outdoor chess area, a barbecue zone, a dog park and children's play areas add variety, while food and beverage outlets and retail and dining at ground level make everyday life convenient.

Apartments are fitted with modern appliances and finished with Italian marble flooring, quartz countertops and quality wood joinery, while floor-to-ceiling windows enhance space and natural light. Efficient layouts suit singles, couples and families alike. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and built-in appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and making each apartment easy to personalise.

##### Location description and benefits

Azizi Riviera is a large waterfront community within Meydan One in Mohammed Bin Rashid City, inspired by the French Riviera and built around a crystal lagoon. A long boulevard lined with cafes, boutiques, supermarkets and restaurants, landscaped parks, walking paths and a lagoon beach create a lively yet relaxed setting, with everyday needs within walking distance of every building.

Al Khail Road and Meydan Road connect residents with the wider city. The Meydan Hotel and Meydan Racecourse are close by, Downtown Dubai, The Dubai Mall and Business Bay are a short drive away, and Dubai Design District, Dubai Creek Harbour and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable driving distance for work, leisure and travel.

Azizi Riviera is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the most popular mid-market waterfront addresses close to Downtown Dubai. Ready homes with lagoon views, integrated retail and an established community attract professionals and families, supporting steady rental demand. Competitive prices and a central location underpin attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners and investors.
